span.p:
CAN controller bus-off: transceiver power/STBY,
CAN_H/L swapped, termination

span.p:
TX not ACKed: nobody on the bus
(motor unpowered)

span.p:
Motor never answers: 24 V supply, CAN id
(Settings → Scan bus), motor fault LED

span.p: Replies stopped mid-run: power dropout → TRIP_CAN_LOST

span.p:
Frozen / NaN replies: encoder or driver;
